best_idea: The server sends a one-shot animation cue per actor on a short cooldown that drops repeats, the weapon class picks the swing clip, and the cue never decides the hit.
decision_why: Keep the cooldown-gated, range-limited server cue and one weapon-to-clip table, but keep the latest cue pending instead of dropping it, send it after the hit resolves, and reject the client-relayed animation message; the donor has no rig, so only the cue shape transfers.
acceptance: A server test asserts a second swing cue from the same actor within 100 ms is held as the latest pending cue and sent after the window, and a client-sent animation message changes nothing; in the browser the swing clip starts on the server hit event and the hit result is the same with the clip stopped.
